## What

Trail 404, slice A (hotfix for 0.11.0). With the checker on, `extract` of Chakra's own source peaked at about 42 GB: its style system is project source, so the field caps never cut it, and each style prop expanded to about 25 MB of JSON, deep-cloned on every memo hit.

- `Converter::convert` (crates/semantic/src/convert.rs) now cuts a converted type that holds more than `MAX_SIZE` types (18,724, a documented constant, no CLI option) to the existing named `Truncated` (its declaration's name, else the checker's text), and the memo stores the cut form. Size is a node count on the freshly converted tree that stops at the budget (`past_size_budget`), not a serialization.
- Budget: the smallest type in the JSON is `{"kind":"any"}`, 14 bytes, so a type past 256 KiB / 14 types is more than 256 KiB: no type under 256 KiB of JSON is cut (a const assertion and a unit test hold the arithmetic).
- Limit kind: reuses `TruncationLimit::Depth` (doc widened in core and in docs/architecture/types-and-output-contract.md). `Members { total }` would claim a member count the type does not have; a new variant would change the JSON schema, the stored format and the napi/TS types in a hotfix. No diagnostic: the existing `Truncated` cuts add none.
- Every path: all conversions go through `Converter::convert` (component props via `convert_roots`, arguments, members, `instantiate.rs`, and `OnDemand`'s `answer_on`, which builds the same `Converter`). The memo stores the cut entry; `KeptProps` holds `SemanticProp`s built from converted types, so they hold the cut form; `PartsSeen` holds the checker's raw text, no converted types. The kept answer on disk (kept.rs) stores the prop types through `stored.rs`, where `Truncated`/`Depth` already round-trips (core stored tests); its fingerprint covers crates/semantic/src, so an answer kept by 0.11.0 (uncut) is discarded, not replayed. Format unchanged.
- Changeset (patch): output changes only for prop types whose single type passes the budget.

## Evidence

- Tests that fail on origin/main (checked by running them against origin/main's convert.rs): `crates/semantic/tests/size.rs`, a generated project with 130 `Conditions`, 100 `ConditionalValue<string | number>` style properties and 20 components taking `css?: SystemProperties` (main: `Styled00.css holds 39401 types`; fix: cut to `SystemProperties`), and `Near` (exactly 18,724 types, kept in full) vs `Over` (18,727, cut). Unit tests in convert.rs for the budget arithmetic and the walk.
- Gates, by exit code: `just lint doc-check machete typos` 0; `cargo nextest run -p caliper-docgen-semantic -p caliper-docgen-core` 0 (1312 passed); `just test-checker-lane` 0; `gate_harness determinism --src gate-large/src --tsc built-in` 0 (`ok: true`, every variant equals the first).
- Identity vs a release build of origin/main 7b8f6d0d (`extract --json --quiet --no-cache`, JSON parsed, `stats` dropped, one process at a time): IDENTICAL on checker-default/chakra-only/src, gate-large/src and Mantine core (57 MB). Also IDENTICAL on shadcn-ui/apps/v4, ant-design/components and react-spectrum/packages (default cache): no prop cut there.
- Chakra (corpora/chakra-ui/packages/react/src, fixed binary, fresh cache, `/usr/bin/time -l`): CLI defaults 4.48 s, max RSS 6.90 GB, footprint 6.61 GB, output 178 MB; weekly flags (`--load-dependencies --collapse-inherited-props none`) 4.49 s, 6.84 GB RSS, 6.58 GB footprint, 178 MB. Before (diagnosis): 41.7 GB, 15.5 s, 3.87 GB output.
- Chakra cuts: 7 props cut whole at the top (`startAddonProps`, `endAddonProps`: InputAddonProps; `startElementProps`, `endElementProps`: InputElementProps; `rootProps`: StackProps; `branchProps`, `branchContentProps`: TreeView*Props). The style props (`_hover`, `css` and the other `SystemStyleObject` conditions) keep their shape and hold `SystemProperties` cut by name inside.
- Other corpora (fixed binary, defaults): shadcn 1.32 s / 1.00 GB RSS; antd 1.44 s / 1.09 GB; react-spectrum 1.54 s / 0.85 GB; output identical to origin/main.

## Not verified

- The node budget is looser than the 256,000-byte prototype: Chakra lands at 6.6 GB / 178 MB (the prototype's 1 MB-budget point), not 4.36 GB / 108 MB, because Chakra's types average about 40 bytes per type; 150 Chakra props are still between 256 KiB and 732 KB. A tighter cut would break the "nothing under 256 KiB is cut" rule.
- An exact count of every Chakra prop changed by the cut: origin/main was not run on Chakra (by rule), so only the top-level cuts are counted exactly.
- gate_harness memory, first-answer and watch modes were not run; nor an OnDemand-specific test of the cut (the path shares `Converter::convert`).
- The memo still deep-clones on a hit (Part C of the diagnosis), and the one-shot path has no heap budget (Part B).
